node: Retail shelf access, private-label displacement and category control
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around the chokepoint where large retailers control shelf access, private-label programs, replenishment workflows, and category data. The reference lane is Walmart, because it owns the shelf/private-brand control point. The underfollowed lane emphasizes non-obvious public companies that either manufacture retailer private-label products, provide category/private-brand services, or supply the retail integration plumbing required for replenishment and compliance. No trading recommendation is implied.
